changes.summary: Recover No-root Home broker after directory mode drift (#505)
Report restart triggers from the No-root cleanup adapter; the original Developer Mode recovery remains open
Read interrupted native Root setup status without staging Python; the original deployment failure remains open
Show unknown Change Home status in Root Settings
Allow No-root installs on confirmed ramfs
Fix Root compositor auto-return after app exit
Fix TLS and weather navigation on legacy webOS
Fix Debloat defaults and writes over root SSH
Stop Home Helper automatically before No-root reinstall

acceptance: Accepted on LG OLED55C3RLA (43.21.71, SDK 11.2.0), macOS ARM64, and the Android API 35 ARM64 emulator. Exact No-root install, active-Helper reinstall and removal, Debloat read/write and restore, signed Root installation and retained rollback, rendered profile retention, and Magic Remote Home and emergency exit passed. See [v1.18.1 candidate acceptance](https://github.com/Razdva122/clean-your-tv-lg-webos/blob/release/next/docs/history/2026-11-12-release-1.18.1-candidate.md) for hashes, matching legacy fixtures and scope.
